{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (invalid sentinel value)
valid_customers = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age of valid customers
mean_age = valid_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Also compute the number of valid customers
n_valid = valid_customers.shape[0]

# Print both values
mean_age, n_valid"}
